name: saw-forge-hub
description: Install, update and launch Saw Forge apps — free, open-source music software.
author: Saw Forge

scripts.dist:win: npm run pack-apps && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run pack-apps && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --publish never
scripts.release:win: npm run pack-apps && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --publish always
scripts.release:mac: npm run pack-apps && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --publish always
